note: Triennial election of the fourteen electoral divisions of Newry No. 1 (County Down) rural district, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. Two contests, Ballyholland and Glenn (Irish News, 6 June 1958, p. 1; results Irish News, 7 June 1958, p. 1); nine divisions returned unopposed; no nomination for Carrickcrossan, Donaghmore and Mayo, whose outgoing members were regarded as re-elected (Newry Telegraph, 24 May 1958, p. 1). No nomination was received; the outgoing member was regarded as re-elected. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
